_note: Per-dataset SPEC-CARD fields (biology / experimental design). Joined on `id` to dataset_facts.json, which stays the source of truth for CELLS and METHOD (platform) — those are NOT duplicated here. Values are either (a) read live from the backing .h5ad / author metadata, (b) transcribed from prose already in the repo, or (c) supplied by Steven from the published spec card. Provenance for every non-obvious value is recorded in `_provenance` below. Anything not sourced is the literal string "TBD" and is waiting on a human — do not fill these in by inference.

_provenance.genes: n_vars, read in backed mode. zscape + zscape_commit_gold + chemfish 32,031; daniocell 30,121; megafin_parse + minifin 32,520; megafin (Lawson) 36,351.
